title: A characterization of Keller maps
author: Piotr Jedrzejewicz
publication: Journal of Pure and Applied Algebra 217 (2013), 165-171
portions_inspected: Introduction, Corollary 4.2 and Theorem 5.1 with its proof: Keller pullbacks of irreducible polynomials are square-free. The v2 correction of Lemma 3.5 is respected.
role: Primary context and attribution. The needed forward square-free statement, coprime-pullback statement, cyclic-eigenvector argument, divisor-class descent and quadric class-group calculation are all proved in the new note.
